temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals and sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because he has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dangerously overworking due to hospital obligations, and that a relaxation retreat could help him recover and gain perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's refusal confirms that his work pressure is intense and that a simple invitation to rest may not be enough to make him step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan still believes Gary's health is at risk, but now thinks Gary is either unable or unwilling to accept an easy intervention because of his hospital workload.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat disappointed or frustrated.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan wants to keep trying to help Gary, likely by finding another way to support him or persuade him to address his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits things are complicated and says he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked mainly because of professional obligations, though he may already sense there is more going on.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now suspects and then learns that Gary's overwork is tied to deeper problems beyond ordinary hospital duties, and that Gary has been withholding them to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is struggling with something complicated and personal, not just work overload, and that Gary needs safe, nonjudgmental support to open up.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worried, empathetic, and concerned for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to encourage Gary to share what is really going on and to reassure him that he can be trusted and will not judge him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has deeper issues beyond work and is reluctant to share them, but Ethan does not yet fully understand the causes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now understands the specific pressures Gary faces and sees that Gary is willing to accept help and make changes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork comes from new departmental pressures and personal challenges, but that with planning, delegation, and support, Gary can begin finding a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to help Gary organize his schedule, delegate responsibilities, and find a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has started improving with support, but may still be facing challenges and need continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan sees concrete evidence that Gary is making real progress and that his support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is moving toward a healthier work-life balance and is capable of sustaining positive change, though he may still need some support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to continue checking in, encouraging Gary, and offering support whenever needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control now. Ethan sees that Gary can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has improved significantly and still benefits from support, but may no longer need active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now believes Gary has achieved sufficient independence and no longer needs regular help to maintain his balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has successfully established a healthier work-life balance and can manage his own life well.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to step back from actively managing Gary's situation while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
